name: The Book of Ur
summary: Keeper Bel'dugur sends Horde champions into Shadowfang Keep for The Book of Ur. In the Undercity's Apothecarium, he seeks the treatise of Ur, a dead mage of Dalaran, for the Forsaken's use of its research into other planes.

sections.title: A Relic of Extramundane Magic
sections.body: Before the Third War destroyed Dalaran, the brilliant human wizard Ur devoted his scholarship to realms beyond Azeroth. The Kirin Tor strictly governed conjuration and contact with outer planes, but Ur studied beings from other dimensions, including the savage worgen. He hesitated to wield their alien powers, judging them dangerously uncontrollable. That restraint made his written legacy a coveted prize for those with fewer scruples.

sections.title: The Fall into Dark Hands
sections.body: Archmage Arugal took Ur's treatise and used its research before settling in Shadowfang Keep. Without Ur's reservations, Arugal summoned bloodthirsty worgen into Silverpine. Their curse consumed Pyrewood and the surrounding valleys. The volume now lies neglected in the keep's towers, watched by Arugal's feral pets.

sections.title: The Forsaken's Ambition
sections.body: Keeper Bel'dugur and the Royal Apothecary Society see Ur's fate as mortal frailty, not a warning against hubris. Bel'dugur believes conscience left Ur unable to act when danger came. The Forsaken seek the Book of Ur for the Undercity, intending to set aside its academic hesitation and harness its extradimensional lore. They mean to secure their survival and uphold Sylvanas Windrunner's rule across Lordaeron.

faq.answer: Ur was a notable Dalaran mage who studied magic and other worlds before the Third War. He researched extradimensional creatures, including worgen, and died during the Scourge invasion of Dalaran.

faq.q: Where is the Book of Ur located?
faq.answer: The Book of Ur lies inside Shadowfang Keep, on a bookshelf in the chamber of Fenrus the Devourer, deep within the fortress.
Keeper Bel'dugur is a Forsaken archivist and researcher in the Undercity's Apothecarium. He gathers dark, arcane, and extramundane lore to advance the power and survival of the Forsaken.

faq.q: Why does the Forsaken want the book?
aliases: why do forsaken want ur's book
faq.answer: Bel'dugur and his cohort want Ur's research into extraplanar beings so the Forsaken can harness those powers. They believe Ur failed to survive the Scourge because conscience kept him from exploiting what he found, and the Undercity intends no such hesitation.

faq.q: How did the book end up in Shadowfang Keep?
aliases: how did arugal get the book
why is the book in sfk
faq.answer: After Dalaran fell, Archmage Arugal acquired Ur's notes and used them to summon worgen into Lordaeron. He brought the research to Shadowfang Keep when he seized the fortress.

faq.q: Is the Book of Ur related to the worgen curse?
faq.answer: Yes. Ur's research described the dimension where worgen originate. Arugal used the treatise to unleash the beasts upon Silverpine Forest, causing the infestation there.

angles.text: Ur's Book is a grim part of Kirin Tor history. It shows how theoretical research into otherworldly beings could be twisted by unstable practitioners like Arugal into apocalyptic curses.
Ur's curiosity about what lies beyond mortal reality echoes a warlock's hunger for extraplanar knowledge. Bel'dugur says Ur failed because he lacked the nerve to wield what he discovered.
Recovering the book serves Lady Sylvanas and the Royal Apothecary Society. It supports the Forsaken belief that survival means embracing forbidden lore without mortal squeamishness.
Clearing Shadowfang Keep and securing Arugal's sources helps stabilize Silverpine Forest and curb the feral worgen menace near Horde-held lands.
